sources.title: Home - YomiToku
sources.snippet: YomiToku is a Document AI engine specialized in Japanese document image analysis. It provides full OCR (optical character recognition) and layout analysis capabilities, enabling the recognition, extraction, and conversion of text and diagrams from images.
